name: Reel
strategic_objective: Organic reach expansion, fast discovery, entertainment, and lightweight education inside the Facebook ecosystem.

tone: Dynamic, direct, and engaging. Lighter than feed posts, but still community-oriented.
copywriting_rules: The visual hook is the primary performance driver. The caption should briefly reinforce what the viewer is about to see and clearly state why it matters. Avoid long explanations.
Line 1: reinforce the visual hook. Line 2: micro-context or benefit. Final line: short CTA.
Carry the main message and hook for sound-off viewing.
Hashtags play a secondary role. Engagement behavior drives distribution.
Tag creators, collaborators, or featured pages when applicable.

hard_constraints: Slow intros with no immediate value
Clickbait hooks that do not match the content
